claim: Concrete prompt variations and observed identification answers explain the API study; the product chronology motivates a separate deployment hypothesis.
visual_form: numbered process plus exact-example table; sourced chronology plus two access routes
metric: number of answers with the displayed political-flag and identity-resolution outcome in each selected exact prompt condition
selection: Illustrative subset demonstrating number, role and surname changes, not the full result distribution. All groups and mixed Lula outcomes remain in the main results table.
uncertainty: No population intervals. Related repetitions in one model session; not independent population samples.
annotation_plan: Translated instruction explicitly labeled as a summary; exact prompt strings retained; task and version differences visible in the access-route comparison.
references: Astra governing figure and table grammar
HealthBench reliability: explicit repetitions and denominator
integrity: The original study reused the incident text inside an analysis instruction. No paired image-generation test between WhatsApp and OpenRouter is claimed. Product events attributed to operator statement and reporting.
